name: bounded default-dry-run native 64-token paged KV gate
source_repository: original mlx2 implementation based on private codex/varlen-paged-attention revision b23b8793b
license: original mlx2 project code; no third-party implementation copied
modifications: Added default-dry-run, CPU-fake, and opt-in native modes for a 2-head d128 fp16 63/64/65-token page boundary. Native mode checks both live gpuq owner receipts, pinned source/binary hashes and wheel version, uses a hard 300-second SIGALRM, and records a failure stage and hashes on exception. It uses one explicit GPU stream, exact per-head/page diagnostic reads, callback-gated publication and generation retirement.
validation: CPU-only dry-run/fixture tests, fake byte-plane ownership checks, matching/mismatching lease and hash preflight, and failure receipt generation. The bounded native GPU 63/64/65-token write/readback gate passed on 2026-10-03 under the pinned source/binary/wheel and gpuq lease recorded in qualification/runs/varlen-token-native-20261003/receipt.json.
limitations: This source-bound pass does not prove attention on the opaque arena, COW, failed GPU command-buffer retirement, cross-stream ordering, model parity, performance or serving.
